title: The Classroom Door Opens Again

shots.image: her teaching notebook on a table in morning light, close view
shots.motion: the notebook pages flutter in a breeze

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By 2015, life had taken another turn.

shots.image: {TEACHER} walking calmly along a leafy lane with {DAUGHTER11} and {SON9} in school uniforms, seen from behind
shots.motion: they walk together peacefully, morning light
shots.sfx: footsteps, birds, distant traffic, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: After my separation, I made a decision that changed my professional journey.

shots.image: {TEACHER} walking through a cheerful school gate with flower beds and a big tree, seen from behind
shots.sfx: school bell, children chatting, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I happily stepped into a classroom as a teacher.

shots.image: {TEACHER} opening a classroom door, sunlight pouring in, seen from behind
shots.motion: the door swings open into light
shots.sfx: door opening, children's voices, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It felt like opening a door I had left closed for years.

shots.image: {TEACHER} teaching at a whiteboard to a bright classroom of students of different ages, side view
shots.motion: she points at the board, students raise hands
shots.sfx: marker on whiteboard, classroom ambience, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I began teaching different grade levels, preparing lessons and helping students understand new ideas.

shots.image: a schoolboy raising his hand at his desk, {TEACHER} walking towards him, seen from behind the boy

lines.speaker: STUDENT
lines.text: Ma'am, can you explain this once again?

shots.image: {TEACHER} kneeling beside the student's desk explaining with colourful blocks, side view
shots.motion: she arranges the blocks, he nods

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: Of course! Let's try it in a different way.

shots.image: a sunny school staff room, {COLLEAGUE} handing {TEACHER} a cup of tea, side view
shots.sfx: tea cups, soft chatter, no music

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: It felt wonderful. I think I'm right where I belong.

shots.image: {TEACHER} walking through the school garden past a big tree, students playing nearby, seen from behind

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Slowly, I found my confidence again.

shots.image: {TEACHER} at home arranging teaching materials and colourful flashcards beside a laptop, side view
shots.motion: she opens the laptop, its glow lights her
shots.sfx: papers shuffling, laptop opening, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: This time, I was ready to build something of my own.
